head: cloud/functional-runner-flake
title: test(functional): give non-hung runner children time to start under load
body:
> AI disclosure: I am not a software developer. Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) developed and tested this patch; an independent Claude Fable 5.1 review approved it before submission; this is not a claim of human developer review. Claude Code cloud session, CPU only, no GPU testing.

Test scope: `python3 tests/functional/test_runner.py` (the `functional_runner_test` CTest command) on a 4-core cloud VM, CPU only. Ran directly with Python, not through `ctest`. No GPU, model or server runs.

## Problem

`functional_runner_test` can fail on a loaded host. The failing subtest is the last case of `test_failed_or_incomplete_child_is_not_reported_as_a_pass`, the child that writes a passing report:

```
FAIL: test_failed_or_incomplete_child_is_not_reported_as_a_pass (...) (child='import json,sys; from pathlib import Path; p=Path(...); p.write_text(json.dumps({"status":"passed"})); ...')
AssertionError: 'failed' != 'passed'
```

Every case runs with `--suite-timeout .2`, so each child must start a Python interpreter, import `json` and `pathlib`, and write two files within 200 ms. When the CPU is contended, startup alone takes longer, `subprocess.run` times out, and the runner reports the passing child as failed. Only the `time.sleep(10)` child needs the short timeout.

## Change

The hung child keeps `--suite-timeout .2`. Every other child gets 60 s, which only bounds a hang and does not slow the test: those children exit as soon as they finish. The expected statuses are unchanged.

## Evidence (CPU only)

Contention reproduced by pinning the test and 10 `yes` busy loops to one core (`taskset -c 0`):

| Revision | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `main` (f948ddd) | the single test, 5 runs | 5/5 failed (`'failed' != 'passed'`, the passing child) |
| `main` (f948ddd) | full `test_runner.py`, 2 runs | 2/2 failed, only that subtest |
| this PR | the single test, 10 runs | 10/10 OK |
| this PR | full `test_runner.py`, 3 runs | 3/3 OK |
| this PR | full `test_runner.py`, unloaded | OK (78 tests) |

Under that load, `taskset -c 0 python3 -c 'import json,sys; from pathlib import Path'` took 0.39 s wall time on its own.

Built in a cloud session (CPU only); Strix Halo validation pending.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

review.summary: Minimal, correct fix: only the sleep(10) child keeps the 0.2 s suite timeout, other children get 60 s so Python startup under CPU contention no longer times out. Independently reproduced: main fails 3/3 pinned to one loaded core, PR passes 3/3, full 78-test file passes unloaded in 5.7 s. Diff matches the branch, PR title passes the repo checker, disclosure is first line with correct model names, test scope exact and CPU-only, every body claim is in the evidence, no sensitive data, no duplicate. Approve.
